title: Construction of a NETosis-related gene signature for predicting the prognostic status of sepsis patients.

models.outcome_definition: overall survival in GSE65682 (28-day follow-up); time ROC at 7/14/21 days
models.expression_scale_used: GEO processed expression; risk score then z-score standardized
models.cutoff: high (n=254) vs low (n=225) groups; cutoff method not stated
models.reported_performance: GSE65682 time-ROC AUCs at 7/14/21 d described as high (values in figure); KM separation in GSE95233; survivors lower score in GSE185263 and GSE95233
models.source_location: Results 'Establishment and verification of clinical prognostic model' (formula), Fig. 7

notes: Methods say n=7 and 'Cox regression coefficient' from stepwise regression; final model has 5 genes. WGCNA/DEG/PPI on GSE57065. GSE185263 used for risk score vs survival status comparison -> cannot be used for evaluation. ssGSEA programmed-death analyses also run on all four datasets.
